input.quote: Vendor grants Customer alone a non-transferable licence, revocable at Vendor's sole discretion, to use the Services without Affiliates or contractors.
input.rationale: The subscription grant in 13.1 is revocable at Vendor's sole discretion and expressly excludes Affiliates and contractors with no path to add them — the walk-away case. The paid-up grant in 13.2 and the revocation limits in 13.3 do not cure the Services licence itself, so we extended 13.1 to Affiliates and contractors, made it transferable per Section 24, and tied revocation to Section 13.3.
